title: Cover My Home
hook: Father, tonight I'm bringing my family to you, one name at a time.
prayer: You know their hearts, their tiredness and the battles they don't always talk about. Thank you for every hug and every shared meal, even on our imperfect days.
Cover our home with your peace. Keep us from harm, from sickness and from words that wound. Where there is distance, bring us back together; where there is weariness, give us rest.
Watch over the ones who are far away and the ones on the road tonight. Let each of them know they are not alone.
Teach us to love patiently and to forgive quickly. Make our home a place where your name is spoken with gratitude.
tiktok_description: A prayer to cover your family tonight. 🏡 Tag someone you're praying for.
